contexts.text: Flash... as with diamond spherules.
The universal atmosphere consists of such lightnings.

For as the lightning goeth forth from the east, and appeareth even to the west, so also shall the Advent of the Son of Man be () = that it was with the internal worship of the Lord as it is with lightning, in that it is at once dissipated; for by the lightning is signified that which is of heavenly light, thus that which is predicated of love and faith. The east = the Lord... and the west, what has set or ceased to be... thus the lightning... from the east... to the west = dissipation.
The flashing of colours there. Explained... Their flashing is from the good which is of wisdom. AC 4530:end.
His face as the aspect of lightning () ... = the good of love.
(Lightning a sign in Jupiter of disagreement.)
Lightning () = the resplendence of Divine truth which glances on the Intellectual, and bereaves it of the faculty of seeing truth. Illustrated.
By lightning is meant truth Divine in ; .
The torches or lightnings () = the resplendences which truths have from the good of love.
Colours which flash...
Carbuncle, in the Hebrew, is derived from a word which means flashing, such as there is from fire.
Out of the throne... lightnings... () = illustration. From the flame which glances on the eyes, lightnings = illustration. Illustrated. AR 396. AE 273.
Lightnings, voices, and thunders () = reasonings.
Voices, lightnings, and thunders () = reasonings, falsifications of truth, and argumentations from falsities.
As it were lightning flashed upon the walls...
Such lightning is a sign to us of the coming of the Ancient one from the east...

I saw through the window as it were lightning flashing, and presently I heard as it were thunder rolling, (which) were correspondences of the combat and collision of arguments (concerning) God and nature...
Lightning is predicated of the illustration of Divine truth.

Lightnings and thunders... in general = Divine truth received and uttered by the higher Angels, and which when it descends to the lower Angels sometimes appears as lightning, and is heard as thunder with voices. Hence it is that lightning = Divine truth as to illustration; thunder, Divine truth as to understanding; and voices, Divine truth as to perception. Illustrated.
Lightning () = the light of Divine truths; which, as they vivify and illustrate the good, so do they terrify and blind the evil...
Hence the things which fall down from the Third Heaven correspond to thunder, and those which fall down from the Second Heaven correspond to lightning...
His arrow shall go forth as the lightning () = truth illustrated, thus truth from the good of love.
Lightnings are mentioned from the light of Heaven.

Thunders and lightnings = conflicts and disturbances of the affections and derivative thoughts concerning good and evil, and truth and falsity... Such things... appear at a distance, where they are not heard, as thunders and lightnings; as thunders from the conflict of affections; and as lightnings from the conflict of the derivative thoughts. Explained. AE 702.
He maketh lightnings for the rain () = illustration from the influx of Divine truth with them.
In a confined sense, by lightnings are signified thick darknesses of the understanding.
The light itself of truth from good then appears as lightning...
